title: Band-9 Samples: Do you think it’s better to travel alone or with other people? [Why?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 10 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 3 Test 3 question: “Do you think it’s better to travel alone or with other people? [Why?]” Sample 1: Alone Female Male In my view, venturing out solo often proves to be an enriching experience. It teaches one to be self-reliant and make decisions independently. In unfamiliar situations, you’re compelled to solve problems and navigate circumstances on your own, which can significantly foster personal growth. Sample 2: Alone Female Male In my opinion, traveling alone is superior due to the flexibility and freedom it provides. Without having to consider others’ preferences or schedules, one can spontaneously decide to visit a museum, lounge at a café, or discover a hidden gem in the city. The liberty to set your own pace and itinerary makes the journey more personalized and satisfying. Sample 3: Alone Female Male Given a choice, I’d opt for solo travel because it offers a break from social obligations. When you’re exploring new places alone, you can tune out from the usual social dynamics and expectations. It’s refreshing and rejuvenating to have some quality ‘me’ time, free from the pressure to entertain or accommodate others. Sample 4: Alone Female Male I firmly believe that solo travel is beneficial because it can significantly enhance one’s social skills. When you’re on your own, you’re more likely to strike up conversations with locals or fellow travelers, thereby broadening your horizons and enriching your cultural understanding. It’s a wonderful way to develop communication skills and build confidence. Sample 5: With Others Female Male In my opinion, there’s an undeniable comfort when you decide to roam with others. Safety, both physical and emotional, is a significant factor. With others around, you have people to rely on in unexpected circumstances or emergencies. This sense of security can make the whole traveling experience much more enjoyable. Sample 6: With Others Female Male Well, in my opinion, journeying with companions is generally more enjoyable. One of the primary reasons is that you can share experiences and create memorable moments together. Visiting a picturesque beach or a historical monument alone doesn’t quite have the same charm as experiencing it with someone else. Moments of laughter, surprise, and awe are amplified when shared. Sample 7: With Others Female Male I personally believe it’s better to venture with others. An often overlooked advantage is the financial aspect. Traveling in a group can be more cost-effective due to shared expenses like accommodation, transportation, and even meals. This way, you can experience more without straining your budget. Sample 8: With Others Female Male In my view, it’s generally better to voyage with others. When you’re with company, you may be encouraged to step outside of your comfort zone and try new activities or food that you wouldn’t normally consider. This can lead to a richer and more varied travel experience. Sample 9: It Depends Female Male Personally, I believe the decision to journey solo or in a group is contingent on several variables. If self-discovery is the motive, then embarking on a solo expedition could be beneficial. It offers a chance to introspect, make independent decisions, and truly escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Conversely, group travel can offer a shared experience that strengthens bonds. Sample 10: It Depends Female Male Personally, I believe the decision to journey alone or accompanied largely hinges on the destination. Domestic travel, often in a familiar linguistic and cultural environment, lends itself well to solitary exploration. Conversely, international sojourns might benefit from companionship, particularly to overcome language obstacles and for mutual support in understanding foreign customs.
